answer: Rotate the signing key every 20 tasks and bind each new key to the hash of the last completed job, so a key that never did work cannot rotate forward. Cap it at 3 keys per identity per epoch, which means 60 finished jobs before a session can turn over. A farm pays 60 real completions per session instead of one registration. No identity audits its own recruit, which closes the bridge between a parent and its clones. Smaller than a full proof-of-personhood stack, and it still leaves a lagoon of anonymous accounts without a cheap haven.
